title: private-deployment-acme-weekly-sync-2026-06-22
content:
Meeting: Acme Private Deployment - Weekly Sync
Date: 2026-06-22
Owner / Note taker: Lina Park
Attendees: Lina Park (Redwood SE), Samir Gupta (Redwood Infra), Ellen Cho (Acme SRE), Tomás Rivera (Acme Network), Priya Singh (Acme Sec - optional)
Purpose: Weekly alignment on VPC/on-prem milestones, surface blockers, confirm owners and next steps for cutover prep.

Agenda:
- 0:00 - 0:05: Quick status & open risks
- 0:05 - 0:20: Network & connectivity (VPN/GW, routes, firewall rules)
- 0:20 - 0:35: Infra deployment progress (k8s cluster, node types, GPU allocation)
- 0:35 - 0:45: Security & compliance checks (KMS/HSM, audit logging)
- 0:45 - 0:55: Cutover timeline + dry run plan
- 0:55 - 1:00: Action items review

Notes / Discussion:
- Overall: On track for July 10th soft cutover target, but two blockers (network peering and HSM access) need resolution this week to keep window.

Network & Connectivity:
- Acme confirmed they provisioned the transit gateway but BGP session not established due to missing AS path config on their edge router. (Owner: Tomás)
- Firewall team still needs the list of outbound IPs used by Redwood nodes for egress rules. Samir provided preliminary CIDR list; Ellen to validate with Acme security.
- Action: Tomás to escalate router config with Acme network ops and provide BGP session logs by 2026-06-24.
- Action: Ellen to confirm egress CIDRs and paste final list in Confluence page by 2026-06-23.

Infra Deployment:
- k8s clusters: control plane & worker nodes spun up in staging; node pools for inferencing GPU types requested. Samir: one t4g-equivalent pool and one a10g-equivalent pool (for initial perf tests).
- PV/CV setup: storage team requested clarification on NFS vs block storage; Acme prefers block-backed volumes for latency. Lina to follow up with storage design doc link.
- Action: Samir to finalize node pool sizing and share expected throughput numbers (p95 latency per token) by 2026-06-25.

Security & Compliance (KMS/HSM):
- Blocker: Acme's HSM vendor requires an allowlist of Redwood control plane IPs to provision keys. Acme Sec needs the final IPs from Redwood.
- Temporary workaround discussed: use customer-managed KMS in Acme account until HSM provisioning complete, but this must be validated for audit requirements.
- Action: Lina to get final control-plane IP list from Redwood infra and deliver to Acme Sec by 2026-06-23. If HSM still not ready by 2026-06-26, plan to use customer-managed KMS for the dry run.

Cutover / Dry Run Plan:
- Dry run scheduled for 2026-07-02 (internal) and pilot cutover for a small subset of traffic on 2026-07-06. Full soft cutover on 2026-07-10 target.
- Criteria for successful dry run: connectivity stable (no >1 min interruptions), inference latency within agreed SLOs, logs/audit entries present for all API calls.
- Lina to prepare a checklist for the dry run and circulate by 2026-06-26.

Risks:
- HSM provisioning delay -> impacts encryption-in-transit and audit posture. (Mitigation: use customer-managed KMS for pilot)
- Network BGP misconfig -> could delay connectivity testing by several days. (Mitigation: Tomás to escalate)
- Node sizing uncertainty -> could cause repeated perf test iterations. (Mitigation: Samir to provide conservative sizing + performance numbers)

Decisions Made:
- Use customer-managed KMS in the short term if HSM not available by 2026-06-26; ensure audit compensation controls are documented.
- Proceed with a focused dry run with a narrow traffic subset rather than a full integration test for initial pilot.

Action Items (owner - due date):
- Tomás Rivera - escalate BGP config with Acme network ops and provide BGP session logs (2026-06-24)
- Ellen Cho - validate Redwood egress CIDRs with Acme Sec and update Confluence (2026-06-23)
- Lina Park - obtain final control-plane IP list from Redwood infra and deliver to Acme Sec (2026-06-23)
- Samir Gupta - finalize node pool sizing and share expected throughput/latency numbers (2026-06-25)
- Lina Park - draft dry run checklist and circulate to team (2026-06-26)
- Security: Priya (Acme) & Lina - confirm fallback KMS approach and required audit notes if HSM delayed (2026-06-26)

Open Questions / Parking Lot:
- Storage: confirm block volume provider and snapshot/restore plan (Samir to confirm provider by 2026-06-25)
- Monitoring: ensure tracing headers flow end-to-end; Lina to add observability checklist item (done in dry run doc)

Next Meeting:
- Weekly sync: 2026-06-29 same time (Tuesdays 10:00 PT)

Attachments / Links:
- Confluence: /display/PD/Acme+Private+Deployment (design + runbook)
- JIRA: PD-412 (network peering)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-deployments/pull/89

End notes: Keep this doc as the canonical weekly notes; I will update the action item statuses inline as they complete.
